label: Updated 12 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: David Skinns leads RBC Canadian Open
items.text: David Skinns is leading at 10-under through 15 holes, tied with Ben James; Jacob Bridgeman and Viktor Hovland are one shot back at 9-under.

items.headline: Nelly Korda’s LPGA comeback
items.text: Nelly Korda and Olivia Cowan shot 60 on Friday to reach 10-under and lead the Dow Championship four-balls through 36 holes.

items.headline: RBC Canadian Open schedule concerns
items.text: Players like Nick Taylor say a proposed closed-field Track 1 status for the RBC Canadian Open would likely end its 'Open' format and impact Canadian players' opportunities.
